channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: India: Inflation steady, trade deficit persists – DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research’s Econs team expects India’s July inflation to remain steady at 4.4% year-on-year, with core readings staying below 4% thanks to softer precious metals. Food staples show mixed trends, while fuel price adjustments may lift utilities and fuel components.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention skepticism meets BoJ repricing – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad highlights growing market skepticism about Japan’s FX interventions, despite sizeable recent operations that triggered sharp but temporary Japanese Yen (JPY) rallies.

item.title: EUR/GBP Price Forecast: Mixed momentum signals point to more consolidation
item.description: The Euro (EUR) edges higher against the British Pound (GBP) on Friday, although price action has been confined to a narrow range over the past ten trading days, suggesting that the mid-July rebound from below 0.8500 is losing steam beneath a dense cluster of moving averages.

item.title: Silver price rallies to six-week high ahead US jobs data
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) extends its strong rally on Friday, trading around $64.10 at the time of writing, up 4.16% on the day.

item.title: Euro: Fed repricing supports moderate gains against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Thu Lan Nguyen argues that the US Dollar's (USD) current support from perceived hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) policy is likely to fade as markets reassess United States (US) rate expectations over coming quarters.

item.title: US Dollar: Fed tightening risks keep outlook bullish – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong highlight renewed Dollar support from higher Oil prices, rising US yields and resilient US labour data as markets reassess Federal Reserve tightening risks.

item.title: WTI Oil pulls back below $76.00 amid ongoing talks to reopen Hormuz
item.description: Oil prices are trimming gains on Friday, with the barrel of the US benchmark West Texas Intermediate (WTI) trading just below $76.00 at the time of writing, on track for a 10% weekly decline.

item.title: Mexican Peso: Restrictive Banxico stance supports MXN carry – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s Molly Schwartz and Christian Lawrence note that Mexico's central bank, Banxico unanimously kept the overnight policy rate at 6.50% on August 6 and continues to judge the stance as appropriate.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Likely find direction after US NFP release
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) consolidates against its major currency peers on Friday, with investors awaiting the United States (US) Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data for July, which will be published at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: Euro: Upside bias hinges on 1.1565 break against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann report EUR/USD has retreated to 1.1524 after failing several times near 1.1560. Intraday, they see scope for further pullback but expect strong support at 1.1495 to hold.

item.title: US July Nonfarm Payrolls to test expectations for a September Fed rate hike
item.description: The United States (US) Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is set to release the Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data for July on Friday at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: Gold rises above $4,300 as traders brace for US Nonfarm Payrolls
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) extends its recovery on Friday as technical buying accelerates, even as market sentiment remains cautious due to developments in the Middle East and uncertainty over the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) interest-rate outlook.

item.title: US Dollar: Strong payrolls may offer only limited support – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad expects the July United States (US) non-farm payrolls to show resilient labor demand, with consensus around 80k jobs and unemployment steady at 4.2%.

item.title: Oil: Prices jump on Hormuz tensions – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Michael Wan notes that Oil has spiked on renewed tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, even as Brent remains below US$85/bbl. He highlights Iran’s proposed restrictions on US and Israeli ships and regional conflict risks.

item.title: Indian Rupee drops on oil price bounce, US NFP in focus
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) falls slightly against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday in the countdown to the United States (US) Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data for July at 06:00 PM IST or 12:30 GMT.

item.title: Canadian Dollar lacks direction ahead of twin US, Canadian employment releases
item.description: USD/CAD trades around 1.4020 on Friday at the time of writing, up a modest 0.06% on the day with no clear directional bias as investors remain cautious ahead of the release of US and Canadian July employment reports.

item.title: Australian Dollar edges up against US Dollar with NFP data in focus
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) trades slightly higher to near 0.7040 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Friday.

item.title: Euro clings to gains near three-week highs ahead of the US Nonfarm Payrolls report
item.description: The Euro (EUR) is trading flat, a handful of pips below 1.1530 against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, following a mild pullback from three-week highs at 1.1560 earlier on the week.

item.title: 1.1560: Why the Euro's recovery is facing its biggest technical hurdle
item.description: The Euro (EUR) has staged a notable recovery from its mid-June lows against the US Dollar (USD), driven in part by financial markets dialing back expectations for further Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate hikes.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD rallies further with bulls eyeing $4,380 area
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) resumes its bullish trend on Friday, after a brief consolidation on Thursday, to reach fresh three-week highs above $4,300, with bulls aiming for mid-June highs in the $4,380 area.

item.title: US President Trump: Warsh is great and I won’t criticize him
item.description: United States (US) President Donald Trump said in an interview with Punchbowl, released during the European trading session on Friday, that a potential interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve (Fed) is not completely on Chairman Kevin Warsh, but on the entire board.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: Labour resilience favours CAD against US Dollar – TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities strategists expect Canada’s July Jobs Report to confirm ongoing labour market strength, with employment rising another 20k, matching consensus and extending the recovery of 2026 job losses.

item.title: Polish Zloty: Near-term EUR/PLN forecast raised to 4.30 – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose raises the near-term EUR/PLN forecast from 4.20 to 4.30, citing recent global risk-off moves and uncertainty surrounding the oil price shock.

item.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Dollar eases towards 0.8100 ahead of the NFP release
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) pares gains against the Swiss Franc (CHF) on Friday, with the USD/CHF pair drifting towards the 0.8100 level, after rejection at 0.8136 highs on Thursday.

item.title: NFP or Iran: Which factor will break the US Dollar Index out of its consolidation?
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY) trades around 99.95 at the time of writing on Friday, virtually unchanged on the day, as investors refrain from placing aggressive bets ahead of the release of the July US employment report.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Friday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $64.34 per troy ounce, up 4.58% from the $61.52 it cost on Thursday.

item.title: US Dollar: Labour market still solid – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team expects United States (US) Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) to rise by 70k in July, with the unemployment rate steady at 4.2% and average hourly earnings up 0.3% m/m.

item.title: Swiss Franc: Funding currency weakness extends – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note the Swiss Franc (CHF) remains under pressure as carry trade funding demand grows and recent Japanese Yen (JPY) intervention reinforces CHF’s role as a preferred funding currency.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Upside risk tied to 0.7075 break against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note AUD/USD has pulled back to 0.7032 after failing to clear 0.7075, with intraday price action expected to remain range-bound between 0.7015 and 0.7055.

item.title: Japanese Yen holds onto weekly losses amid absence of US-Japan intervention follow-up
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) has underperformed its major currency peers this week due to a lack of follow-up joint intervention by the United States (US) and Japan.
